title: serve
description: The HTTP+SSE bridge for the dispatcher cockpit: expose the x-web command surface and the event streams on 127.0.0.1 (API-only; the cockpit UI runs on its own origin and proxies /api here). Long-running; Ctrl-C to stop. Prints the pairing URL (with the token fragment) once at startup.

rotateToken.description: re-mint the pairing token, print the new pairing URL, and exit
